statsConsent.title: HELP IMPROVE STARSOWN?
statsConsent.message: Starsown can share your star-pop counts and a random installation ID for aggregate statistics and the online player count. Only these values are sent. You can change this later in Options.

presenceConsent.title: SHOW STARSOWN ON DISCORD?
presenceConsent.message: While Discord is running, Starsown can show what you're doing in the game (the screen you're on, and for how long) on your Discord profile. It talks only to the Discord app on this computer. You can change this later in Options.

splashes: Rainbow stars are rarer than you think!
